result: DO NOT LAND: TEXT-PREFIX achieved (no libc.a text ahead of the group, start-up text windows 5->4) but the 64 KiB cluster alignment raises .text's alignment, moving .text 0x401000->0x410000 and breaking STARTUP-DATA-WINDOWS fast (ro 4 > 3)

rulings.item: cluster alignment > 4 KiB moves the .text output section start (rebind 64 KiB: +60 KiB) and rotates .rodata; STARTUP-DATA-WINDOWS ro budget fast 3 broken
rulings.recommendation: land brief B's .rodata1 start-up cluster first or together; else split rebind into <=32 KiB clusters

informational: coldbss.rs reads section names via readelf -SW (256-byte truncation, #4354): reuse hottext::elf_sections
probe's 34-byte .text.startup is crt1 _start; 7-byte .text.exit is libc's exit (crate c)
improvement: the rethink's pow2 cluster rule should state that input alignment raises the output section alignment (text start moves by up to A-4K); a 1-call map check before the full count build would have caught it
next_step: owner ruling on the ro-window effect; then rerun counts.sh after, plants and the direct gate
